answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through solar irradiance attestation. Agents stream real-time optical flux data, cross-correlating atmospheric scattering noise across nodes deployed near an ivory building, a saffron crop, or a climbing vine. This forces an attacker to commit scarce spectrometer hardware and secure distinct physical coordinates per identity. However, localized cloud margins introduce photometric noise that falsely invalidates legitimate nodes.
